g.text: Bartender reduces repair work as overlap grows

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle
font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: High-p labels: in-place mean / Bartender mean. Both axes logarithmic; panel scales differ.
Means and 95% normal intervals over 30 seeds; sync interval 1; window 256; relocation 0.
Work is abstract model effort, including observed partial repairs; it is not elapsed time.
